offering_description.value: Produces and sells nitrogen fertilizer products, mainly ammonia and UAN, to agricultural customers. Manufactures them at two plants in Coffeyville, Kansas and East Dubuque, Illinois, using pet coke and natural gas as feedstocks.

customer_segment.value: B2B: agricultural retailers, distributors, farmers and industrial users of ammonia

end_markets.value: agriculture; row crop farming; industrial chemicals

revenue_model.value: product sales: UAN and ammonia sold at market-based prices, delivered by truck, rail and barge

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: converts pet coke, natural gas and other inputs into nitrogen fertilizer sold to agricultural distributors and farmers

geography_served.value: US national: Central US Corn Belt including the Plains and Midwest states, within about 200 miles of plants

specialization.value: related lines: UAN and ammonia nitrogen fertilizers from two plants

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sold to agricultural retailers, distributors and industrial customers; other: delivery via truck, rail cars and barge from plant loading facilities and terminals

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, chemical safety and emissions rules (EPA, OSHA, DHS chemical security)
